decision: Reject v35 promotion; retain frozen v30
interpretation: Complete-PCM phone controlled extra binary supervision improves one generator but does not consistently improve source generalization or background activation. Does not disprove all synthetic training or phone-based supervision.
next_hypothesis: Diagnose source-specific signal level, duration, voice and speed failure distribution before another training change; keep VCTK development separate from training and reserved final voices untouched.
limits: Historical thresholds independently selected; counts not matched population FAR. Synthetic intention events and generation-reference windows are not phonetic recall or phonetic latency.
